data.one_liner: A Flutter package to use Material side sheets.
data.what_it_does: Provides components for both modal and standard side sheets in Flutter applications following Material Design guidelines. Includes the showModalSideSheet function and the BodyWithSideSheet widget.
use_when: You need to display content in a modal side sheet that blocks interaction with the rest of the screen.
You need standard side sheets that co-exist with the primary UI region on tablets and desktops.
avoid_when: You require complex custom transitions not supported by the package.
You do not use Material Design components in your app.
strengths: Supports both modal and standard side sheets.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, web, macOS, Linux, and Windows.
weaknesses: Initial version 0.0.1 with potential missing features.
